messages:
Marco (Sales): Heads up — Finlytics POC in EU is blocked. They pinned model `rwd-gpt-large-v1` to eu-west-1 and keep getting a 503 with payload `model_unavailable_in_region`. Need triage, customer is on a paid pilot and asks for ETA.
Jamie (SE): Can you paste the raw API call + response body? Are they using Hosted API or Dedicated trial?
Marco (Sales): Hosted (trial reserved capacity). API call: `POST /v1/generate` body includes `model: \"rwd-gpt-large-v1\"`, `region: \"eu-west-1\"`. Response: `503` and body `{"error":"model_unavailable_in_region","detail":"requested model binary not provisioned in region"}` — req_id `req_0a1b2c`.
Rita (SRE): I pulled logs for req_0a1b2c — the control plane returned a placement error from the model catalog. Looks like that exact model build was deprecated last week in eu-west infra due to a quantization rollback.
Finlytics POC (Customer): This is blocking our demo tomorrow. Is there a manual way to unpin to a compatible variant? We can't move data outside EU, requirement from legal.
Jamie (SE): Two options: 1) fallback to `rwd-gpt-large-v1-quant-eu` (compatible variant) if allowed, or 2) reprovision the pinned build in eu-west-1 which takes ops time. Which is acceptable for you (and does it pass your security review)?
Anita (Security): If they accept a quantized EU variant we need to confirm KMS/HSM key usage — the current pilot uses customer-managed keys. Quantized build must be signed and use the same KMS policy; otherwise compliance flags it.
Lee (Product): Quick note — we deprecated that non-quant build because of perf regressions on the latest kernel. We do have a verified `-quant-eu` build flagged as compatible but it's not in the pinned fallback policy for Hosted by default.
Rita (SRE): Ops can reprovision the original build in eu-west-1, but ETA ~ 6-8 hours given capacity checks and validation. If customer needs <2h, enabling fallback to `-quant-eu` is faster (minutes) but must pass Anita's KMS check.
Marco (Sales): Customer says they can accept the quantized variant as long as KMS is customer-managed and audit logs stay inside their VPC. They asked for cost delta too — will quantized be cheaper?
Jamie (SE): Quantized runs ~30% cheaper per-token on our benchmarks. I can send a quick cost delta doc. Also note slight quality change; we should flag to customer.
Anita (Security): To approve, we need confirmation that the quantized artifact is signed with the same provenance and uses their KMS key. @ops-bot can you check the artifact signing metadata for `rwd-gpt-large-v1-quant-eu`?
ops-bot: artifact-check: `rwd-gpt-large-v1-quant-eu` -> signed: true, sign_key: `kms://projects/finlytics-eu/keys/poc-key`, provenance: verified, acl: restricted.
Rita (SRE): ops-bot confirms KMS reference present. I'm going to flip the temporary fallback policy for the Finlytics tenant to allow `rwd-gpt-large-v1-quant-eu` for region=eu-west-1. Will monitor for 2h canary.
Lee (Product): Locking note — we should add this variant to the default compatible fallback list for Hosted EU to avoid repeated escalations. Filing follow-up ticket.
Marco (Sales): Forwarding to customer: proposed plan: enable quantized EU fallback now (minutes), ops will monitor canary 2h, if fine we'll keep it; otherwise reprovision original build (~6-8h). Customer agreed.
Finlytics POC (Customer): Thanks — please confirm once fallback is enabled and share any quality notes. Also need written confirmation KMS keys are used and logs stay in our EU project.
Anita (Security): I'll send a short note confirming sign_key and audit log retention policy. Also: include in the security questionnaire addendum.
Jamie (SE): Sending cost delta + small sample comparison to customer. Attaching quick eval notes: small BLEU/ROUGE diffs, nothing critical for their demo use-case.
Rita (SRE): Fallback enabled for tenant `finlytics-123` -> `rwd-gpt-large-v1-quant-eu` now serving. Monitoring metrics: tail latency 85th=120ms, error rate: 0.2%.
Marco (Sales): Customer confirmed they see responses. Demo rescheduled to tomorrow 09:00 CET, they asked if we can add a line to the quote about fallback/rollback SLAs.
Lee (Product): We'll add a line to the POC addendum template around model fallback and KMS invariants.
Marco (Sales): Great — thanks team. Closing the loop with Finlytics and I'll drop the security addendum to Legal. :thumbsup:
Anita (Security): I'll post the verification note to the security questionnaire thread and cc legal.
Jamie (SE): If anything else pops up ping me.
Rita (SRE): I'll keep the canary running and escalate if errors >1%.
ops-bot: deploy-log: fallback-policy update applied for tenant finlytics-123 by rita_sre — change-id cid_8921
Marco (Sales): Thanks all.
